messages:
Josh L: kicking off rollout v2.14.3 -> eu1 (canary 10%). will monitor synths and healthchecks.

deploy-bot: rollout started: release=v2.14.3 scope=eu1 canary=10%
deploy-bot: running post-deploy synthetic checks: embed_probe, kv_prefix_probe, latency_tail_check
```
checks: [embed_probe, kv_prefix_probe, model_variant_check]
thresholds: embed_p95 < 240ms, kv_err_rate < 0.5%, tail_latency < 600ms
```

Carla M: seeing embed_p95 jump to ~420ms on eu1 synths, started ~2m after canary started. not huge errors but latency spike.

Priya S: can you paste the raw query? I want to see per-host distribution.

Carla M: sure, PromQL snippet: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embed_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le, host, region))`

Anita K: thanks — looks like a small subset of hosts trending high, likely cold-KV or kernel scheduling on that fleet. not seeing serving errors (4xx/5xx) though.

Marco R: copying metrics: `embed_p95{region=\"eu1\"}` -> 420ms on hosts eu1-gpu-07 and eu1-gpu-09. cpu steal a bit high on -09.

oncall-bot: automated alert: eu1 embed_p95 > 300ms sustained 90s, severity=info

Josh L: hold rollout at 10% for now. do not advance.

Priya S: two possible immediate mitigations: 1) pin traffic in eu1 to model-quant-v2.14.2 (previous variant) which has warmer KV hit patterns, or 2) run targeted warmup traffic to affected hosts to populate KV/prefix caches.

Anita K: prefer warmup first — lower blast radius and cheaper. can run synthetic warmup for those hosts only. but if latency remains high we should pin.

Marco R: warmup plan: run `infra warmup` for hosts eu1-gpu-07, eu1-gpu-09 with 8 concurrent prefix requests for 5m.

Carla M: executing warmup now.

Carla M: run command: ```
infra run warmup --region eu1 --hosts eu1-gpu-07,eu1-gpu-09 --model v2.14.3 --concurrency 8 --duration 300
```

deploy-bot: warmup job queued: job_id=wu-20260401-73 region=eu1 hosts=2

oncall-bot: note: warmup traffic will appear in cost dashboards, tagging as release-activity.

~4m later

Carla M: warmup finished. rechecking synths — embed_p95 back to ~220ms across region. hosts eu1-gpu-07/09 dropped to ~230ms.

Priya S: nice. that suggests cold-KV/warm path. I recommend: 1) keep rollout at 10% for another 15m, 2) schedule automatic targeted warmup in the rollout pipeline for eu regions for the next N releases, and 3) add release-note blurb about increased warm cache needs for this variant.

Josh L: agree. also add an immediate micro-change: enable `targeted_warmup=true` flag for eu1 in this rollout, so future canaries warm affected hosts automatically.

Anita K: I'll add a quick blurb to the release notes and create a follow-up ticket to add warmup to the canary pipeline. ticket: INF-4621.

Marco R: implementing the flag now. `kubectl patch deployment deployer -n infra --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"metadata": {"annotations": {"targeted_warmup":"true"}}}}}'`

deploy-bot: rollout held at 10% for v2.14.3 in eu1. config patch applied: targeted_warmup=true.

Carla M: continuing to monitor for the next 15m. so far stable.

Josh L: if no regressions, proceed to 50% at T+20m. document decision in release notes: "eu1 warmup enabled; observed transient embed p95 from cold-KV; mitigated with targeted warmup, no rollback needed."

Priya S: I'll add the release note and a short ops runbook entry on the synthetic warmup command.

Carla M: ack. thanks all. :thumbsup:
